svg.title: Figure1 | tmol
svg.desc: Minimal-label molecular overview and GPU execution diagram. The caption supplies implementation details. Three real neighborhoods feed independent CTAs, shared atom tiles, logical register state and energy/gradient outputs. Measured score-plus-gradient and latest-tmol FastRelax throughput versus atom count; one pooled Pearson estimate and bootstrap confidence interval per score term across all chemical categories against PyRosetta.
